--- ratio=0.99
LIVE: Displayed near the bottom of the page. In addition to the primer sequence, the length, calculated melting temperature (Tm) and suggested annealing temperature (Ta) are displayed. The primer display is automatically updated whenever the mutation region or desired sequence is changed. Forward and reverse primers are color coded and the 3-frame coding sequence is shown allowing the user to verify that the desired mutation is incorporated.
V284: Displayed near the bottom of the page. In addition to the primer sequence, the length, % GC, calculated melting temperature (Tm) and suggested annealing temperature (Ta) are displayed. The primer display is automatically updated whenever the mutation region or desired sequence is changed. Forward and reverse primers are color coded and the 3-frame coding sequence is shown allowing the user to verify that the desired mutation is incorporated.
--- ratio=0.83
LIVE: Home Page About this application NEBaseChanger is a simple yet powerful tool to design primers for site-directed mutagenesis experiments using the Q5 Site-Directed Mutagenesis Kit. In addition to generating primer sequences, an annealing temperature (Ta) for the PCR is calculated with knowledge of the preferred PCR polymerase, its buffer composition, the preferred primer concentration and any mismatches or loops within the primer. The Q5 Site-Directed Mutagenesis Kit enables rapid, site-specific mutagenesis of double-stranded plasmid DNA in less than 2 hours. The kit utilizes the robust Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase along with custom mutagenic primers to create insertions, deletions, and substitutions in a wide variety of plasmids. NEBaseChanger will design the custom mutagenic primers for use in the Q5 Site-Directed Mutagenesis Kit. Primers designed for this kit can accommodate more complex mutagenic strategies than other commercial SDM kits including multiple substitutions within a 100 nucleotide region or insertions up to 100 nucleotides long. In addition, due to the use of back-to-back primers, there is no limit to the size of the deletion that can be introduced using this kit. System Requirements This application is best used on modern web browsers that are compliant with HTML5 and CSS3 standards. Javascript must be enabled for the tool to work. Updates v2.11.0 October 10, 2026 Changing the ORF start no longer clears the mutations you&#39;ve entered; any that no longer match the new reading frame are skipped with a warning. Typing in the sequence box is faster on long sequences. A sample vector that fails to load now shows an error and leaves your sequence unchanged. Pressing Enter in the mutations box builds primers; switching modes keeps a minimum primer length you set. Help buttons, dialogs and all controls work from the keyboard, with visible focus and labels for screen readers. Long help dialogs fit the window and keep their Close button in view; the page can be zoomed freely. Fixed searching at either end of a partial sequence, and undefined appearing when a coordinate was cleared. v2.10.0 October 9, 2026 Work (sequence, mutations, settings and primers) is now kept when you visit Help, About, Resources or Troubleshooting and come back. Repaired Help page links and bookmarks Fixed issue where clicking a codon after returning from another page no longer opened the substitution dialog. v2.9.0 October 8, 2026 Accuracy and reliability update. Fixed the primer table sometimes freezing (showing primers for an earlier entry) after an invalid character was typed; invalid input now shows a warning instead. Fixed primers and sequence downloads for mutations near either end of partial (linear) sequences and across the origin of circular sequences. Every primer pair is now checked against the intended mutant sequence before it is shown or downloaded. Corrected melting temperatures (TA/AT and A\xB7C mismatch nearest-neighbor values) and degenerate base handling (IUPAC B and D codes, S/W complements). Primers are named the same way in the table and every download ( ID _ n _F / ID _ n _R), and lowercase marks the mutation in every download. NEBuilder primers: duplicate sites and short fragments across the origin are now flagged, and the table order no longer changes when the option is switched on. Downloads report problems instead of failing silently; FASTA files are wrapped at 70 characters. v2.8.4 July 10 2026 Repaired file downloading issue when mutation was a deletion.. v2.8.3 June 23, 2026 Added Q5-SDM troubleshooting module. v2.7.3 March 2, 2026 Minor edit to Help to clarify when the NEBuilder option is accessible. v2.7.2 March 2, 2026 Repaired reverse primer using partial sequence input, where the rev primer 5&#39; end was off by 1 nt. v2.7.1 February 17, 2026 Repaired misplaced reverse primer when using partial sequence input. v2.7.0 February 9, 2026 Added link to NEBuilder Calculator when NEBuilder primers are generated. v2.6.10 February 6, 2026 Repaired broken Save Summary function when NEBuilder primers were generated. v2.6.9 December 12, 2025 Bundled release includes following feature enhancements: support for partial template sequences. support for merged mutations in Codon mode. Legacy mode to emulate NEBaseChanger V1. text selection of target sequences. point-and-click codon selection in codon mode. optional explicit triplet specification for point mutation designation. ORF start reset, ORF auto location, and ORF start set by click in sequence. Added warning that text selection fails in Safari with long sequences. Repaired problems with circular sequence support where mutations/primers span origin. Removed the single-site option from NEBuilder HiFi primer generation. Repaired result sequence download and added download of all result sequences. Updated Help to reflect the new feature set and other changes. v2.5.4 July 15, 2025 Revised shortcut icon (favicon). v2.5.3 June 11, 2025 Removed extraneous underscore from primer ID. Removed link to NEBaseChanger v1. v2.5.2 October 14, 2024 Updated Help text. v2.5.1 July 5, 2024 New NEB logo. v2.5.0 April 16, 2024 Added option to adjust primer minimum Tm and minimum length. v2.4.4 February 15, 2024 Fixed critical issue that prevented download of the final mutated sequence in AA mode. v2.4.3 January 24, 2024 Fixed annoying issue that inserted underscores after every letter in a Primer Set ID. v2.4.2 October 17, 2023 Added option to preserve degenerate base codes in primers. v2.4.1 September 28, 2023 Fixed issue where minimum primer length was still falling below 15 when mutations were confined to 5 \u2032 primer tails. v2.4.0 September 27, 2023 Fixed issue where minimum primer length was falling below 15 when mutations were confined to 5 \u2032 primer tails. Changed definition of X amino acid to represent the codon NNK (was NNN). v2.3.2 September 7, 2023 Changed default selection for NEBuilder Primer type to &#39;multiple&#39;. v2.3.1 August 4, 2023 Raised minimum primer length to 15 nt. v2.3.0 July 17, 2023 Added &#39;All&#39; option to AA dropdown -- equivalent to &#39;NNN&#39;. And added help dialog for one-letter codes. Enforced exclusivity between NEBuilder HiFi primer generation and confining mutations to 5 \u2032 primer tails. v2.2.1 June 27, 2023 Minor changes to UI and documentation. v2.2.0 June 26, 2023 Added NEBuider HiFi-compatible primer generation for AA point mutation mode. v2.1.1 June 7, 2023 Fixed/restored missing Gln to AA replacement list. v2.1.0 June 1, 2023 Added codon selection strategies for AA point mutation mode. v2.0.1 May 23, 2023 Repair OneTrust cookie manager implementation. v2.0.0 May 17, 2023 Initial release of NEBaseChanger V2. This major version upgrade adds: consolidated, streamlined insertion/deletion/substitution input view added new AA point mutation mode added new batch input mode allowing multiple general indel/substitution actions along with AA point mutations added support for ambiguous bases in replacement sequences which generate multiple primer sets added support for choosing between inline mutations (embedded in the middle of the primer annealing segment) and mutations confined to the 5\u2032 primer tail

--- live-only, no v2.8.4 counterpart
LIVE: Every table and download names primers the same way: ID _ n _F and ID _ n _R, where ID is the mutation&#39;s name (for example G10W) and n is the pair&#39;s number in the Required Primers table. In primer sequences, lowercase bases are the mutation and uppercase bases anneal to the template.
